text:
rachel (People Ops): Quick note: perf cycle timeline posted. Self-assessments open now, due Fri Oct 7 23:59 PT. Manager calibration week Oct 10-14. Final manager uploads due Mon Oct 17. Guide + forms: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-oct-2026

daniel (Eng Manager): Thanks — is peer feedback required this round?

rachel (People Ops): Optional but recommended for cross-team ICs. Short peer form in the guide (2 questions).

aisha (IC): If someone started Sep 20 (2+ weeks), do they get a rating?

rachel (People Ops): Policy: hires <30 days = no formal rating. Managers should add 2-3 bullet "Onboarding & Ramp" notes in the manager form.

marta (Recruiter): Can we make Onboarding & Ramp required for hires <60 days? hiring ops needs visibility.

rachel (People Ops): Done — required for <60 days this cycle. Keep it 1-3 bullets (focus, checkpoints).

daniel (Eng Manager): Extension policy? one of my reports is out for surgery during calibration week.

rachel (People Ops): Standard extension up to 3 business days via the extension form. For medical accommodations >3 days submit an Exceptions request (HR review). Link in guide.

srini (Director): I'll reserve a 90-min Eng calibration slot Wed Oct 12 09:00-10:30 PT. If teams need alternate times, add availability in the doodle.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessments due in 7 days" will post to #people-ops and #eng.

aisha (IC): Is there a template for self-assessments?

rachel (People Ops): Yes — Self-Assessment Template in the docs. TL;DR: 3 bullets: accomplishments (with metrics/links), one impact example, 1 dev goal (~200-300 words).

daniel (Eng Manager): How are final ratings delivered to ICs? automated email?

rachel (People Ops): After managers submit final uploads, peopleops-bot will send an autogenerated summary email with rating + manager comments within 72 business hours. Managers: review comments before submit.

marta (Recruiter): Hiring ops asks: can managers mark Promotion Signals in a structured field?

rachel (People Ops): Added an optional Promotion Signals checkbox + short evidence field. Keep notes evidence-based (1-2 bullets).

daniel (Eng Manager): Can we get a paste-ready invite body for calibration meetings? timezone-saver.

rachel (People Ops): Sure — copy/paste:

Subject: Calibration — Team {NAME}
Agenda: 1) Context & scope (5m) 2) Borderline cases (50m) 3) Finalize ratings & notes (25m)
Prep: scoring sheet, 2 evidence links (PRs/metrics), list of hires <60d

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager calibration week starts in 3 days" to post to #people-ops and team channels.

aisha (IC): If managers want to change a rating after calibration, what's the path?

rachel (People Ops): Managers can request recalibration within 3 business days via the recalibration form. Include scoring CSV + evidence links to speed triage. IC appeals follow HR policy.

daniel (Eng Manager): Filed an extension for one report. Thanks for the fast-track note.

rachel (People Ops): Got it Daniel — I'll fast-track and confirm by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for edge cases. :wave:
